translations.web: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
translations.bsb: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
translations.kjv: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
